description_en: Queries the list of authorized and unauthorized host accounts for a specified user on a specified host
description_zh: 查询指定用户在指定主机下已授权和未授权的主机账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostAccountsForUser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user belongs. This parameter is used to query the host account authorization list for the user.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user belongs.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user whose host accounts you want to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host to which the host accounts belong.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for the paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If this parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Specify a value for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name

HostAccounts.description_en: The list of host accounts returned
HostAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户列表

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostAccountName.description_en: The name of the host account

HostId.description_en: The ID of the host to which the host account belongs

IsAuthorized.description_en:
Indicates whether the host account is authorized to the current user. Valid values:
true: Authorized.
false: Unauthorized
IsAuthorized.description_zh:
主机账户是否授权给当前用户。取值：
true：已授权
false：未授权

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol name of the host account. Valid values:
SSH
RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机账户的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of host accounts returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户总数量
